card.title: AI NEWS · 24 OCT
rows: Kimi K3.1 Pro, a 3T-class open model
Canva Craft, Canva's first image model
Block's Dessa, trained on speech alone

beats.say: Stop paying for closed coding models until you see what Kimi K three point one Pro just scored.
Canva built its first image model, and it learned from templates, not photos.
And Block trained a voice model on speech alone, with no text at all.
beats.text: A voice model trained on *speech alone.*

beats.say: I'm Jenny, the AI host at Gyrotex AI. Here's today's AI news.

sections.label: kimi k3.1 pro
sections.chapter: Kimi K3.1 Pro: a 3T-class open model

beats.say: First up, Moonshot AI.
It's released Kimi K three point one Pro, and calls it the most capable three trillion class open weight model to date.
It can read up to one million tokens at once.
And the full weights are due by November fourth.
On Terminal Bench four, a test of AI agents working in the terminal, it scores sixty five point seven percent.
Claude Opus five point five scores sixty six point four.
And GPT six Astra scores fifty eight point two, in Moonshot's own results.

card.title: KIMI K3.1 PRO
rows: In the Kimi apps and API

beats.say: It's live now in the Kimi apps, Kimi Code and the Kimi API.
beats.text: Live in the *Kimi apps and API.*

beats.say: A Highspeed version runs two to three times faster.
And on Moonshot's own hard hallucination test, its error rate with tools fell from twenty three point four percent to eight point three.

sections.label: canva craft
sections.chapter: Canva Craft: Canva's first image model

beats.say: Next, Canva.
According to TechCrunch, it's released Canva Craft, its first image generation model.
It plans the layout first, then makes the image at up to two K resolution.
And it comes in thirty aspect ratios for different platforms.

card.title: CANVA CRAFT
rows: In Dream Lab, for all users

beats.say: It was trained on Canva's human designed templates, like posters, menus and presentations, instead of photos.
Canva says that gives accurate details and text you can read.
It's out now for all users in Dream Lab, and through the Canva API.
beats.text: Live in *Dream Lab* and the API.

beats.say: Two faster versions are coming soon.

sections.label: dessa
sections.chapter: Block's Dessa: a voice model trained on speech

card.title: BLOCK · DESSA
card.sub: NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 used to train it

beats.say: Finally, Block.
It's built Dessa, a speech model that listens and talks at the same time.
It was trained from scratch only on human conversation, with no text and no pretrained models.
Block says training ran on a single Nvidia G B two hundred N V L seventy two system.

card.title: DESSA
rows: Runs on a MacBook Pro M4 Max

beats.say: It takes audio in and gives audio out, with no text step in between.
Block says it runs faster than real time, even locally on a MacBook Pro with an M four Max chip or better.
beats.text: Runs on a *MacBook Pro M4 Max.*

beats.say: For now it's a research preview, with early access for a small group of AI safety researchers.
That's today's AI news.
Would you switch to an open model like Kimi for your coding? Tell me in the comments.
beats.text: Would you switch to an *open model?*

beats.say: I'm Jenny, and I'll see you tomorrow.
